theme: 3 terms on splitting a screen: the owner controller, the controller inside it, and the steps that connect them

terms.definition: A view controller that holds other view controllers inside its own screen.
terms.example: The Parent View Controller owns the header and the list.

terms.definition: A view controller whose view lives inside another view controller.
terms.example: Make the header a Child View Controller to keep the screen small.

terms.definition: The set of steps that adds a child view controller to a parent safely.
terms.example: Follow View Controller Containment, or the child will not get its events.

video.description:
Learn to explain how one iOS view controller holds another: Parent View Controller, Child View Controller & View Controller Containment, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Parent View Controller - A view controller that holds other view controllers inside its own screen.
Child View Controller - A view controller whose view lives inside another view controller.
View Controller Containment - The set of steps that adds a child view controller to a parent safely.

landscape.description:
Explain Parent View Controller, Child View Controller & View Controller Containment in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
부모 뷰 컨트롤러, 자식 뷰 컨트롤러, 뷰 컨트롤러 컨테인먼트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Parent View Controller - A view controller that holds other view controllers inside its own screen.
한국어: 부모 뷰 컨트롤러: 자기 화면 안에 다른 뷰 컨트롤러들을 품는 뷰 컨트롤러

Child View Controller - A view controller whose view lives inside another view controller.
한국어: 자식 뷰 컨트롤러: 뷰가 다른 뷰 컨트롤러 안에 들어 있는 뷰 컨트롤러

View Controller Containment - The set of steps that adds a child view controller to a parent safely.
한국어: 뷰 컨트롤러 컨테인먼트: 자식 뷰 컨트롤러를 부모에 안전하게 붙이는 일련의 단계

landscape.hook: Can you explain Parent View Controller, Child View Controller and View Controller Containment in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the profile screen is huge. I want to split it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make the header its own Child View Controller.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And the profile screen becomes the Parent View Controller?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The Parent View Controller owns the child and its layout.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I add the child?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Follow View Controller Containment, like in the code.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The Child View Controller never learns its parent, so some events break.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Can the child reach the parent later?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, through the `parent` property. But keep View Controller Containment in the parent.
The Parent View Controller owns the header.
